text: browser_abWhitelist.js uses allowlist in task and subtest names but keeps the whiteListAbURI preference and UI ID. Its tests save and reload address-book URIs through that existing preference. In this family, legacy file names, preference keys and control IDs are compatibility exceptions to the newer wording. Match those keys exactly when reading persisted state; do not rename all related identifiers as a style-only edit. The unchanged file stem does not establish a preferred name for a new unrelated test. These conclusions come from static source inspection. No runtime test or accessibility session was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Keep compatibility names while modernizing local allowlist prose
